# algebra.library: IsNearerThan

**Status:** Supported (tier `foundation`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> True when candidate is strictly nearer to reference than other is.
> Example: origin.IsNearerThan(p, q) tests whether p is closer to origin than q.
